import json, os, subprocess, hashlib, time
from pathlib import Path

SOURCE=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
EXPECTED_MAIN="78d826e019428c1f1b0d98acf45f3c16812ae61a"
projects=[
    Path("/Users/steventran/do-again"),
    Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe"),
    Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary"),
]

def run(cwd,args,env=None):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)
    return {"rc":p.returncode,"stdout":p.stdout,"stderr":p.stderr}

def read_json(path):
    try:
        v=json.loads(path.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

def file_sha(path):
    if not path.is_file(): return None
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

source_head=run(SOURCE,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"])["stdout"].strip()
source_branch=run(SOURCE,["git","branch","--show-current"])["stdout"].strip()
source_status=run(SOURCE,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"])["stdout"]
if source_head!=EXPECTED_MAIN or source_branch!="main":
    raise SystemExit(f"source authority mismatch branch={source_branch} head={source_head}")
tracked=[x for x in source_status.splitlines() if not x.startswith("?? ")]
if tracked:
    raise SystemExit(f"source tracked dirty: {tracked}")

ps=run(SOURCE,["ps","-axo","pid=,ppid=,etime=,command="])["stdout"].splitlines()
procs=[]
for line in ps:
    parts=line.strip().split(None,3)
    if len(parts)>=4 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit():
        procs.append({"pid":int(parts[0]),"ppid":int(parts[1]),"etime":parts[2],"cmd":parts[3]})

def descendants(pid):
    if not pid: return []
    out=[]; frontier={pid}; seen={pid}
    while frontier:
        nxt=set()
        for r in procs:
            if r["ppid"] in frontier and r["pid"] not in seen:
                out.append(r); seen.add(r["pid"]); nxt.add(r["pid"])
        frontier=nxt
    return out

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(SOURCE/"src")

results=[]
for repo in projects:
    root=Path(run(repo,["git","rev-parse","--show-toplevel"])["stdout"].strip())
    key=hashlib.sha256(str(root.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    runtime_root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
    control=runtime_root/"control"
    state=runtime_root/"state"
    runtime=runtime_root/"runtime/do_again"

    requests=control/"automation/do_again/requests"
    receipts=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"
    reqs=sorted(p.stem for p in requests.glob("*.json")) if requests.is_dir() else []
    recs={p.stem for p in receipts.glob("*.json")} if receipts.is_dir() else set()
    pending=[r for r in reqs if r not in recs]

    claims=control/"automation/do_again/claims"
    claim_rows=[]
    if claims.is_dir():
        for p in sorted(claims.glob("*.json")):
            j=read_json(p)
            rid=str(j.get("request_id") or p.stem)
            if rid in pending:
                claim_rows.append({"request_id":rid,"claim":j})

    daemon=[r for r in procs if f"--repo {root}" in r["cmd"] and "do_again.service.daemon" in r["cmd"]]
    daemon_pid=daemon[0]["pid"] if daemon else None
    kids=descendants(daemon_pid)

    outbox=state/"browser_outbox"
    outbox_ids=sorted(p.stem for p in outbox.glob("*.json")) if outbox.is_dir() else []

    dry=run(root,["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(root)],env=env)

    results.append({
        "repo":str(root),
        "branch":run(root,["git","branch","--show-current"])["stdout"].strip(),
        "head":run(root,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"])["stdout"].strip(),
        "status":run(root,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"])["stdout"],
        "runtime_key":key,
        "daemon_pid":daemon_pid,
        "daemon_children":[{"pid":r["pid"],"ppid":r["ppid"],"etime":r["etime"],"cmd":r["cmd"][:500]} for r in kids],
        "pending_requests":pending[-30:],
        "active_claims":claim_rows[-20:],
        "browser_status":read_json(state/"browser_status.json"),
        "outbox_ids":outbox_ids,
        "liveness":read_json(state/"liveness.json"),
        "upgrade_journal":read_json(state/"runtime_upgrade.json"),
        "installed_runtime":{
            "daemon_sha256":file_sha(runtime/"service/daemon.py"),
            "liveness":(runtime/"service/liveness.py").is_file(),
            "liveness_sha256":file_sha(runtime/"service/liveness.py"),
            "rollout":(runtime/"service/rollout.py").is_file(),
            "rollout_sha256":file_sha(runtime/"service/rollout.py"),
        },
        "current_source":{
            "daemon_sha256":file_sha(SOURCE/"src/do_again/service/daemon.py"),
            "liveness_sha256":file_sha(SOURCE/"src/do_again/service/liveness.py"),
            "rollout_sha256":file_sha(SOURCE/"src/do_again/service/rollout.py"),
        },
        "upgrade_dry_run":{
            "rc":dry["rc"],
            "stdout":dry["stdout"],
            "stderr":dry["stderr"],
        }
    })

print(json.dumps({
    "audited_at_epoch":time.time(),
    "source_main":EXPECTED_MAIN,
    "projects":results,
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
